open_seams: SEAM-0002: The public surface is a minimal static generated page; per-entity and per-axis route families (see site/README.md) remain to be built.
SEAM-0003: Receipt IDs are allocated sequentially from the receipts/ tree; a concurrent-submission allocation policy is not yet declared.
SEAM-0004: Taxonomy deprecation is documented (deprecate-in-place) but no machine-readable `deprecated` flag exists yet in taxonomy files.
SEAM-0005: Author-profile output is exposed via site/data/profiles.json only; no dedicated per-author pages exist yet.
SEAM-0006: Whether the domain list should be expanded further before first external submission intake.
SEAM-0007: Final question slug normalization and canonicalization policy.

SEAM-0008: Shared archive DOIs identify archives containing several distinct member works: 10.5281/zenodo.21212668 (SRC-000002..005, coordinated four-paper release), 10.5281/zenodo.19637774 (SRC-000006..008, Orientation Series I-III), 10.5281/zenodo.17189775 (SRC-000031 The Episteme Construction, SRC-000032 The Common Doorway), 10.5281/zenodo.17980036 (SRC-000023 Provenance & Canon Note, SRC-000024 A Geometry of Admissible Seams). The SourceID identifies the named work; the DOI identifies the archive. Member works are neither collapsed into one object nor counted as separate DOI deposits. Whether member works should later receive their own DOIs is a corpus-owner decision.

SEAM-0009: SRC-000015 (GCD/UMCP whitepaper): the active corpus identifies 10.5281/zenodo.18819238 as the preferred paper DOI; ResearchGate metadata also exposes 10.5281/zenodo.18819239. Observed Zenodo metadata (2026-09-13): 18819238 is registered as the concept DOI whose latest version is record 18893328 (v2.1.5, 2026-03-05); 18819239 is a version DOI (v2.1.3, 2026-02-28) under that concept. Recorded as evidence only; the exact concept/version relationship the corpus intends remains unresolved and is not silently reconciled. One source record and no duplicate object.

SEAM-0010: SRC-000018 (Liber Collapsus): the corpus owner designates 10.5281/zenodo.22310064 as the canonical Liber Collapsus DOI for the Structura Reditus Zenodo community. Zenodo record 22310064 currently carries the title "Liber Universalis de Collapsu Mathematicae" (concept 10.5281/zenodo.16809846) with file liber_collapsus.pdf; record 10.5281/zenodo.22310544 carries the Liber Collapsus title with identical files and declares isNewVersionOf 22310064. 22310544 is not substituted. Title/edition relationship unresolved.

SEAM-0011: SRC-000033 (The Collapse Formalism: A Reader's Guide to the UMCP/RCFT/ULRC Stack): listed DOI 10.5281/zenodo.16990995 resolves (concept) to Collapse Calculus (SRC-000034; versions 16990996, 17007222), whose file listings contain no Collapse Formalism work. Source identity unverified; SR-OBJ-000016 was RETURNED_FOR_REPAIR (RCPT-000016). Repair requires a DOI or archive reference that resolves to the titled work.

SEAM-0012: Zenodo record titles differ from the listed titles for SRC-000016 (record: "Universal Measurement Contract Protocol"; listed: "UMCP CasePack Publication"), SRC-000030 (record: "Generative Collapse Dynamics 4 Tier Stack"; listed: "Generative Collapse Dynamics: Kernel, Platform, Theory, and Governance"; four member PDFs), and SRC-000021 (bundle record title). Listed titles retained; observed titles recorded in each source's missingness. Whether records should be retitled on Zenodo is a corpus-owner decision.

SEAM-0013: SR-OBJ-000017 (Collapse Calculus) and SR-OBJ-000019 (A Geometry of Admissible Seams) are candidate-class historical objects whose public records state no next burden; because candidate material implies a stronger later use, both were RETURNED_FOR_REPAIR (RCPT-000017, RCPT-000019) pending the paper's own stated burden. Submissions archived beside their receipts.

SEAM-0015: Two publishing-protocol documents were supplied: SR-PUBLISHING-PROTOCOL.v1.0 (finalized 2026-08-28; self-declared "final Tier-0 publishing protocol; adopted working standard"; listed by the handoff manifest as "publishing guidance") and SR-PUBLISHING-PROTOCOL.v1.0-rc1 (prepared 2026-08-29; self-declared "internal Tier-0 repair candidate; not canon-frozen"; names a 2026-08-28 repaired working draft as predecessor). Version order and adoption status disagree. Registered as SR-GOV-000014 (unresolved) and SR-GOV-000015 (candidate) with supersedes null; not reconciled. Requires a corpus-owner adoption record.

SEAM-0016: The June 2026 Ingress Paper (SR-GOV-000016, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20549483, under the Orientation Series concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19622272) states that it replaces the former three-part orientation burden. Neither it nor the April 2026 route companion (SR-GOV-000017) states whether the companion remains the active route reference, and no source states that the Orientation Series objects (SR-OBJ-000001..003) become historical. SR-GOV-000017 is registered as unresolved; no object maturity was changed.

SEAM-0017: The governing records SR-GOV-000001..018 and sources SRC-000035..046 were populated from the full-text handoff bundle SR_LIBRARY_GOVERNING_CORE_HANDOFF_v1_0 (SHA256SUMS recorded on each new source as identifier.archive_reference). The bundle, including its PDFs and Markdown specifications, is handoff evidence and is not committed to this repository (ignored via .gitignore). Committing any full text requires an explicit repository policy and licensing decision. Works without a DOI in the bundle (SRC-000035..038, SRC-000039..042, SRC-000044, SRC-000045) therefore have no public archive anchor yet.
